notes.title: v1.08 Patchnotes
notes.notes: Corrected lives counter display and fixed a potential crash when returning to the menu from a hardcore game after losing.

notes.title: v1.05 Patchnotes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a critical bug that was affecting only new players which prevented the theme from loading in as a default due to some changes in v1.04. 

Shout out to the reviews for letting me know there was an issue. I apologize to anyone who experienced that problem, though I'm sure they'll have refunded by now and won't see this. As a solo developer, there's always something new to learn and only so much testing that can be done without a dedicated QA team.

notes.title: V1.04 Patchnotes
notes.notes:
- Added sound effects to several in-game events.
- Added a color flash to a chunk on completion

- Fixed an error preventing a chunk with treasure in it to be marked as complete.
- Fixed an error causing previous game boards to redraw in classic mode.

notes.title: V1.03 Patchnotes - Survival Update
notes.notes:
- Added Survival Mode. Score decreases over time, when it reaches 0, game over.
- Added outline to minimap that scales with your view to assist in finding unfinished cells on your screen.
- Added some optimization to the "flood opening" of '0' cells process to reduce memory usage.
- Added default sleep timer setting to automatically start a sleep timer in infinite modes.
- Added a reminder of the chunk goal number when playing Blitz Mode to pause menu.
- Added a check on load to ensure all stat based achievements are unlocked correctly.
- Added some color changing UI to show when numbers are changed. ie Opening a mine flashes score to red to show penalty.

- Fixed exploded mine count in worlds was not saving. First load of a world should correctly count existing mines.
